_thresholds_source: Thresholds from sota_training_utils.py CONFIG (training-time evaluation gates). For production deployment, real-data backtest thresholds should supersede these.

donor_next_donation_hazard_model._note: Training-time thresholds from sota_training_utils.py CONFIG: max_brier_gate=0.18, min_auc_gate=0.80. Currently deployed as @challenger.

donor_contact_propensity_model._note: Training-time thresholds from sota_training_utils.py CONFIG. Proxy-only model — trained on synthetic/calibrated contact propensity labels. Requires real contact-response labels for production validation.

donor_contact_response_model._note: Training-time thresholds from sota_training_utils.py CONFIG. Proxy model using donated_next_6m target. Real contact-response labels unavailable — uplift claims not supported. Production validation blocked until real labels exist.

donor_priority_policy_model._note: Proxy policy model — requires real outreach utility validation for production. Training-time regression gates (WAPE ≤ 0.25, coverage error ≤ 0.08) apply at model evaluation time.

stockout_time_to_event_hazard_model._note: Training-time thresholds from sota_training_utils.py CONFIG. Sentinel model — not primary production stockout engine.

component_demand_quantile_forecast_model._note: Training-time regression gates (WAPE ≤ 0.25, coverage error ≤ 0.08, worst-group WAPE ≤ 0.35) from sota_training_utils.py CONFIG apply at training/evaluation time. Production routing thresholds TBD after real-data backtest.

component_supply_forecast_model._note: Training-time regression gates (WAPE ≤ 0.25, coverage error ≤ 0.08, worst-group WAPE ≤ 0.35) from sota_training_utils.py CONFIG apply at training/evaluation time. Production routing thresholds TBD after real-data backtest.

component_expiry_waste_model._note: Training-time regression gates (WAPE ≤ 0.25, coverage error ≤ 0.08, worst-group WAPE ≤ 0.35) from sota_training_utils.py CONFIG apply at training/evaluation time. Feeds inventory simulator. Falls back to proxy target if shifted labels unavailable.

component_inventory_risk_simulator._note: Composite pyfunc model. Thresholds TBD after first backtest. Beats reorder-point baseline check required before production. Training-time thresholds from sota_training_utils.py CONFIG apply at evaluation time.
